title: STEERING THE HERD: A FRAMEWORK FOR LLM-BASED CONTROL OF SOCIAL LEARNING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM agents' self-reported posterior beliefs against a strict Bayesian baseline after receiving private signals to identify systematic deviations, such as underreaction to prior-aligned signals, overreaction to counter-prior signals, and central tendency bias.

Simulating an LLM acting as an information mediator (planner) with a state-independent objective (e.g., persuading agents to take a specific action regardless of the true state) and analyzing its emergent strategic policy, expenditure, and subsequent degradation of social welfare.
